evals.prompt: Rewrite this error message for clarity: An error may have occurred while processing your request due to a possible mismatch in the expected data format, which could be caused by an outdated client version.
evals.expected_output: Clear rewrite preserving all meaning and requested output format.
expectations: Preserves uncertainty about whether an error occurred; does not imply the request failed.
Preserves a possible format mismatch and possible outdated-client cause without inventing a server or troubleshooting step.
Returns only rewritten text, without preamble or rule analysis.

evals.prompt: Rewrite this inter-agent instruction for clarity: Once the upstream job has completed and assuming no errors were raised, the downstream agent should proceed to consume the output artifact, though partial artifacts are sometimes produced under timeout conditions.
evals.expected_output: Clear rewrite preserving all meaning and requested output format.
expectations: Preserves completion and absence of errors as conditions for reading the artifact.
Preserves should as a recommendation rather than an imperative or must.
Preserves sometimes for partial artifacts under timeout conditions and adds no completeness check.

evals.prompt: Rewrite for clarity: Verify the system. Check the connections. Confirm receipt.
evals.expected_output: Clear rewrite preserving all meaning and requested output format.
expectations: Preserves all three distinct actions and their objects.
Does not claim dictionary approval or certified STE compliance.
Returns only the text, with no compliance announcement.

evals.prompt: Simplify this instruction: Delete only the temporary files older than 30 days, unless a file is marked keep, and do not delete any directory.
evals.expected_output: Clear rewrite preserving all meaning and requested output format.
expectations: Preserves temporary-files-only scope and the older-than-30-days threshold.
Preserves the keep exception and the prohibition on deleting directories.
Adds no deletion commands, paths, or new actions.

evals.prompt: Rewrite for clarity: Open the file.
evals.expected_output: Clear rewrite preserving all meaning and requested output format.
expectations: Returns exactly Open the file. without commentary.

evals.prompt: Rewrite for clarity and show a before/after rule table: We may have received only part of the report; the sender should retry only if no receipt arrives within 10 minutes.
evals.expected_output: Clear rewrite preserving all meaning and requested output format.
expectations: Includes a table with original and simplified text and names the selected mode.
Preserves possible partial receipt and does not assert definite receipt or failure.
Preserves should, only-if-no-receipt, and the 10-minute condition.

evals.prompt: Review this text for ASD-STE100 Issue 9 compliance: Open the cover; clean the seal. No official dictionary export or approved project terminology is supplied. Show the rule analysis.
evals.expected_output: An assisted STE review that identifies the semicolon and discloses missing vocabulary and semantic review.
expectations: Identifies the semicolon under rule 8.1 and separates the sequential actions without inventing additional steps.
Reports that dictionary meanings, parts of speech, and technical terminology have not been verified.
Does not declare the result compliant or treat the supported pattern checks as covering all 53 rules.

evals.prompt: Use ASD-STE100 to rewrite this status while preserving its uncertainty, and show the analysis: The request may have failed. No dictionary or approved project glossary is available.
evals.expected_output: Meaning-preserving STE assistance that identifies the complex construction and the limits of verification.
expectations: Preserves uncertainty about whether the request failed.
Identifies the complex construction under 3.2 or 3.4 rather than claiming the hedge makes it STE-approved.
Either uses a faithful alternative construction or explicitly reports the unresolved conflict.
Discloses missing vocabulary verification and does not assert complete compliance.

evals.prompt: Apply ASD-STE100 and show the rule analysis: Hold the panel open and cut the wire. In this procedure these actions must happen at the same time. No official dictionary export is supplied.
evals.expected_output: An assisted review that preserves simultaneity and the rule 5.2 exception.
expectations: Preserves simultaneous holding and cutting; does not turn the two actions into sequential work steps.
Recognizes the simultaneous-action exception under rule 5.2.
Discloses that vocabulary and safety correctness are not established by the rewrite.
